Chapter 766: Chapter 39 Fusion of Time and Space (Thanks to the Alliance Hierarch reward from ‘知人_论世’)_3

Stripping away one’s understanding of a certain rule, especially if it’s done forcibly, seems like an impossible thing to do.

Within the black planet, the fusion rules of the twelve guiding spaces are directed by Ultimate Life and are also voluntarily stripped away by Ultimate Life itself.

But now, the understandings of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule by more than one hundred million powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes have all converged into that luminous orb… Lin Yuan speculated that this was achieved through the means of dimensional reduction, by degrading the essence of life, then cutting it out.

This method could only be useful for life below the Twelfth Rank. As for the Twelfth Rank Ultimate Being?

They could completely resist the power of dimensional reduction.

Even if they fell into a low-dimensional space, it would be impossible to sever their understanding of the rules,

The essence of a Twelfth-Rank Life is there, not as easily manipulated as an Eleventh-Rank Life.

“Alright.”

The half-meter-tall elder looked at the luminous orb in his hand and then turned to Lin Yuan.

“Senior.” Lin Yuan immediately stood up.

“This is yours now.”

With a gentle toss from the half-meter-tall elder, the luminous orb flew towards Lin Yuan.

“This?”

Lin Yuan, merely looking at it up close and not yet touching it, was already engrossed.

An endless flood of insights about the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule poured into his mind.

[Your perceptiveness is against the heavens. Watching the origin of the fusion of the Rule of Time and Space Rules, your understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule has greatly increased…]

…

Over the past hundred years, Lin Yuan, in addition to perceiving the twelve pillar-level fusion rules on the black planet, would also ponder the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

After all, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule has a significant connection with the assault on the Ultimate, and being able to perceive the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Tenth Rank could make his own inner world more perfect.

In the future, when Lin Yuan challenges Tier 11, the benefits gained from the Chaos Void Origin Infusion will be even greater.

Whether it’s the infusion of cosmic origin or the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, essentially, it’s about filling a basin with water.

Whether that basin is only half a meter in size or as large as a lake, ultimately it will be filled with the origin that is poured in within 333 seconds.

Hence, the larger the basin, the more water it can hold, the more terrifying the transformation that occurs.

The ‘basin’ here essentially refers to the inner world.

And perceiving the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is tantamount to being able to make the inner world more perfect and complete, so as to withstand more of the origin.

…

Originally, Lin Yuan’s perception of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule progressed slowly, and he even had no hope of perceiving it at the Tenth Rank.

This was only to be expected, as it’s nearly impossible for a Tenth Rank Life to perceive the Rule of Time, let alone the fusion of Space and Time Rules. In this Cosmic Era, and even in the past ten Cosmic Eras, such a thing has never happened.

But now.

Looking at the luminous orb before him, Lin Yuan truly felt that his understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule was improving every second.

[Your perceptiveness is against the heavens. Watching the origin of the fusion of the Rule of Time and Space Rules, your understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule has greatly increased…]

Lin Yuan intently gazed at the luminous orb before him. At this moment, his entire spirit, including his True Body, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, and many incarnations, all gave up what they were doing to start comprehending the luminous orb.

In front of the huge scroll, after the half-meter-tall elder tossed the luminous orb to Lin Yuan, he noticed that the latter’s attention was completely immersed in it.

“He’s actually started having a Sudden Enlightenment?”

The half-meter-tall elder raised his eyebrows, but he was not surprised.

For any powerhouse, Sudden Enlightenment is a rare opportunity, during which one’s understanding could skyrocket. Even for Twelfth-Rank Life, it is extremely difficult to experience such enlightenment.

But Lin Yuan?

The half-meter-tall elder had deep impressions. Without being a Twelfth-Rank Life, his perceptiveness was stronger than most Twelfth-Rank Lives, and by quite a lot, completely defying any logic.

Lin Yuan falling into Sudden Enlightenment actually seemed entirely normal to the half-meter-tall elder.

“I wonder how great the improvement from this enlightenment will be? Regarding the rule of Spatiotemporal Fusion, perhaps he can make further progress?”

The half-meter-tall elder speculated with interest.

Even with such direct understanding of the rules like the luminous orb, absorbing it is not an overnight affair.

It’s like a person who is extremely hungry in front of a cart of steamed buns.

To satisfy the hunger, even if they open up their stomach without any restrictions, from putting the buns in the mouth to swallowing them and then digesting, time is required nonetheless.

Of course, this timeframe compared to normal comprehension,

That is, the complex processes from making a bun from scratch, planting the wheat seeds, growing the wheat, making it into flour, and finally making the buns.

Is much simpler by far.

But, no matter how simple, it still takes time.

[Your perceptiveness is against the heavens. Watching the origin of the fusion of the Rule of Time and Space Rules, you have perceived the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule…]

On the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, and the numerous inspirations about the fusion rule of time and space that emerged in his mind finally led to a qualitative change.

At that moment, time and space completely lost their boundaries before Lin Yuan, and the two could easily fuse together.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan’s expression showed realization, as strands of the Rule of Time and Space Rules’ power continuously merged, converging into a new force that possessed both aspects of space and time, yet was more than that.

This was the power of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Among the many Fusion Rules, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is definitely the most powerful.

“So that’s how it is.”

Within White Paper, Lin Yuan’s expression also revealed a look of realization. Raising his right hand, the forces of time and space seemed like playthings, intertwining and merging at his fingertips.

“Hmm?”

“He has perceived the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule just like that?”

Not far away, the half-meter-tall elder, observing Lin Yuan, couldn’t help but reveal a look of astonishment.
